=== EMAIL to guest@example.com
Subject: primary@example.com has shared their p.stonn account with you
Provenance: You received this at guest@example.com because someone gave this address shared access to their p.stonn account. p.stonn is a free, unofficial scheduler for City of Stonnington visitor parking permits.

primary@example.com has given you shared access to their p.stonn account, which schedules a City of Stonnington visitor parking permit.

Sign in with this email address, and p.stonn will send you a one-time code to confirm it is you. Then tap Accept on the page that opens.

If you already use p.stonn for your own permits, you will find the invitation under Settings. You can’t join another account while you keep your own.

https://p.stonn.org

If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this email. You can also remove your access from Settings after signing in.
